reason: 'shutdown post: The operation has timed out.' is the output of a PowerShell command the agent ran against an old gateway process, and the agent is now waiting on its own install shell ('1 shell still running'). The outage rule's trigger word is the session's own tool output, but the thing that timed out is a local HTTP post, not the model provider, and the session is not stopped on a provider error. Decline.
factsNote: The agent is read off the screen's own chrome (the bypass-permissions bar and the turn summary line are this agent's). The activity state is WaitingForInput because a turn-brief package is built when a turn ends, which is the moment the session goes idle. Machine, repository and mission are not recorded in the package, so they are left empty.
